datasets.name: MIntRec
datasets.version_or_snapshot: repository snapshot used locally; metadata train/test downloaded from official storage, dev not downloaded
datasets.license_or_terms: Repository code is MIT. Dataset/media redistribution terms are not explicitly confirmed in the audited source.
datasets.redistribution_status: not_verified; raw media and downloaded TSVs remain local and ignored
datasets.alignment_statement: The source describes text, audio and video aligned by segment ID; this local run downloaded and validated only text/label TSV metadata, not audio/video presence.

herus_label_mapping.reason: The 20 source labels are outside ARRIVE/HELP/CANCEL; mapping requires new annotation and is not inferred from lexical similarity.

can_prove: Real text/label metadata integrity for the downloaded splits
No duplicate segment IDs between the downloaded train/test splits
Parser out-of-domain rejection/unknown behavior on real English transcripts
cannot_prove: HERUS multimodal convergence, because aligned audio/video were not locally validated
Correctness of an automatic mapping from MIntRec labels to HERUS events

datasets.name: Common Voice Scripted Speech Portuguese
datasets.version_or_snapshot: Scripted Speech v26.0, locale pt, as listed by the official dataset page at audit time
datasets.license_or_terms: CC0 is described by the Mozilla release material for Common Voice data; the exact downloaded package/version must be checked before use or redistribution.
datasets.redistribution_status: version-specific confirmation pending; no files downloaded
datasets.alignment_statement: Each clip is paired with a reference transcript, but the source is not an intent/sensor/multimodal command dataset.

herus_label_mapping.reason: Read speech does not provide HERUS command annotations; no labels are inferred.

can_prove: Potential real-data robustness of an ASR/transcript frontend after a fixed release and permitted download
cannot_prove: HERUS intent coverage without independent annotation

datasets.name: WESAD Wearable Stress and Affect Detection
datasets.version_or_snapshot: UCI dataset record 465 and authors' distribution; exact local snapshot not downloaded
datasets.license_or_terms: Authors' source states scientific non-commercial use with attribution; no broad redistribution license confirmed in the audited material.
datasets.alignment_statement: Pulse/chest sensor streams are synchronized within the experiment; there is no voice or text stream paired to these samples.

herus_label_mapping.reason: Neutral/stress/amusement are benchmark context labels, not ARRIVE/HELP/CANCEL commands.

can_prove: Potential temporal sensor-quality and finite-context experiments after a permitted local download

datasets.name: Fluent Speech Commands
datasets.version_or_snapshot: source page audited 2026-08-27; exact package snapshot not downloaded
datasets.license_or_terms: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0 International; source says academic research only.
datasets.redistribution_status: research-use terms identified; no raw files downloaded or redistributed
datasets.alignment_statement: The source describes a CSV row with speaker ID, audio path, transcription and slots for the same utterance; local ID/file verification has not yet been run.

herus_label_mapping.reason: External smart-home intents are retained as benchmark labels; no lexical or semantic automatic mapping to HERUS is allowed.

can_prove: Potential real audio–transcript–intent convergence in a command-shaped benchmark after a permitted local sample and same-ID checks
cannot_prove: HERUS event convergence without independent mapping annotation
